stages.summary: A 45-second spontaneous answer. Not scored; gives a voice sample to compare with later recordings.

stages.summary: Respond to a discount request above their authority, with quota pressure. Tests deal judgement and maths. Think aloud.

stages.summary: The response to their choice comes back. Tests whether they adapt without panicking.

brief.text: You're an Account Executive at **Shiftly**, which sells field-service scheduling software. List price is ₹1,200 per user per month, billed yearly. You can approve discounts up to 10%; anything more needs your VP.
The quarter ends in **20 days**. Your quota is ₹51,84,000; you've closed ₹31,10,000. Your biggest open deal is **Tanvi Retail**: 60 users, ₹8,64,000 a year.

brief.caption: Tanvi Retail: deal history
rows: Discovery call with Priya Nair, Head of Operations (your champion). Their service team uses spreadsheets and email today.
Demo to Priya and two of her team leads. Very positive.
Proposal sent; the deal moved to the "Proposal" stage. Your team's average time in this stage is 21 days.
Their IT team sent a 40-question security questionnaire. It is still with your security team, unanswered.
Priya mentioned they are "also looking at Zentrix".
Priya calls: "If you can do 25% off, I can get this approved this month. Our CFO, Rahul, signs anything over ₹4,32,000."

brief.text: Their new vendors go through procurement, which usually takes 45 days after a decision. Nobody at Shiftly has spoken to Rahul.
The company and numbers are fictional, and every candidate gets a slightly different version. A calculator is fine.

prompt.text: What is one question you always ask a prospect, and why?
Keep it under 45 seconds. This one is not scored; it just gets you talking.

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

stages.title: What's really wrong with this deal?

prompt.text: **What is really holding this deal up?** Then say how you would forecast it for this quarter (commit, best case, or not this quarter) and why.

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

choices.label: Give the 25% discount so it closes this quarter
Offer 10% in exchange for a two-year contract
Hold the price and ask to meet the CFO with your champion
Offer a free one-month pilot for one team instead of a discount

prompt.text: **How do you respond to Priya's 25% request?** Pick one approach.
Then show what it does to the deal value and to your quarter, and what you will say to Priya and to your VP.

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

variants.label: If they chose "Give the 25% discount so it closes this quarter"

prompt.text: Your VP approved 25%, reluctantly. Priya now says Rahul wants to see "the ROI case" before signing, and that Zentrix has offered 30% off. The security questionnaire is still open.
**What do you do now?**

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

variants.label: If they chose "Offer 10% in exchange for a two-year contract"

prompt.text: Priya likes the two-year idea, but says Rahul "never signs multi-year with a new vendor". She asks if you can do the 10% on one year instead, and mentions Zentrix again.
**What do you do now?**

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

variants.label: If they chose "Hold the price and ask to meet the CFO with your champion"

prompt.text: Priya is annoyed: "I told you I could get it done. Now Rahul's calendar is full for 12 days." Your VP asks why this deal fell out of the commit.
**What do you do now?**

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

variants.label: If they chose "Offer a free one-month pilot for one team instead of a discount"

prompt.text: The pilot started with 10 users, but only 3 have logged in. Priya says the team is "too busy to learn a new tool" this month. The quarter ends in a week.
**What do you do now?**

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.
